title: session.close
description: WORLD_SESSIONS_PLAN §2.5, D6 (WS5): Minecraft has left the world and this game's quit save worked (or it had nothing to save): gen1-bridge releases the region hold, returns a game in play to its title and, when the active slot is a world's, makes the home (offline) slot active again; answered session.closed. Never sent for a game whose quit save failed (D7).

region.description: MG3 (several games): the region this message belongs to; absent = the legacy region. The client tags what it relays with its link's region; the server routes a tagged message to that region's link.
